observations.epoch_band_state_and_other_notes: Audited 2026-09-25. Patterson+02 establishes Porb=0.120560(14) d; the 19.38-min circular-polarization modulation and tentative 1549-s X-ray/UV signal are distinct and neither is a secure spin. VLA epochs are separate 3-sigma limits; stored +/- values after the limit are image RMS, not flux errors. Magnetic classification remains disputed; see measurement ledger/review queue. Existing Ridder+23 X-ray conversions are not simultaneous with VLA and absorption convention is unspecified.

issues.competing_evidence: Rodríguez-Gil+09 finds significant circular polarization and argues the system is magnetic; Wörpel+20 finds no secure IP spin and favors non-magnetic; Bruch+23 adopts the non-magnetic interpretation.
issues.why_it_matters: Changes population comparisons and the interpretation of the polarization signal.
issues.needed_action: Decide whether to retain a disputed class or adopt a provisional magnetic/non-magnetic class after review of the original timing/polarimetry evidence.

issues.competing_evidence: Rodríguez-Gil+09 19.38 +/- 0.39 min CP modulation could be 2(omega-Omega) or 2omega; Wörpel+20 1549 s signal is marginal (~1e-2) and phase folding limited.
issues.why_it_matters: Spin assignment affects magnetic classification and WD spin comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Check whether a later timing/polarimetry analysis resolves the mode assignment; do not fill the WD spin field until then.

issues.competing_evidence: Patterson+02 establishes Porb=0.120560(14)d and reports negative superhump 0.11696d; Eq. 3 repeats an orbital epoch at HJD 2453383.813, 1000d later than Eq. 1. Bruch+23 gives TESS 0.11692d; Dağ+26 explicitly calls 2.807h a negative superhump.
issues.why_it_matters: Confusing these signals would corrupt orbital-period and spin/beat comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Verify Patterson Eq. 3 epoch against source errata or author record; preserve each period with its published interpretation.

issues.competing_evidence: Mickaelian+02 p.1 printed DSS RA 16:43:49.71 is ~50 arcsec from Gaia/SIMBAD, while article states its candidate lies 7.2 arcsec from the X-ray position; exact SIMBAD identifiers link the V1084 Her, RX J, 1RXS and Gaia names.
issues.why_it_matters: A coordinate transcription error could otherwise lead to a false counterpart match.
issues.needed_action: Check original journal scan or erratum for the printed coordinate; retain exact-name Gaia association unless contrary evidence emerges.

issues.competing_evidence: Ak+08 Table 1 gives model distance 305 pc without an uncertainty. Coppejans+15 repeats 305 +/- 137 pc but footnote ordering assigns 45% uncertainty to V1084 Her and 25% to RW Sex, inconsistent with V1084 value if interpreted as stated. Gaia EDR3 geometric posterior median is 465.464 pc.
issues.why_it_matters: A wrong uncertainty affects distance-derived luminosities and CMD comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Confirm Coppejans footnote ordering/possible typo; keep old model and Gaia posterior separate.

issues.competing_evidence: Ridder+23 Table 4 gives approximate converted 1–10 and 0.1–10 keV fluxes but does not specify a V1084-specific absorption convention. Wörpel+20 provides an independent absorbed XMM fit and calls Table 6 flux/luminosity bolometric.
issues.why_it_matters: Mixing absorbed, unabsorbed, band-limited and bolometric quantities biases X-ray comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Retain records separately; confirm the conversion convention from Ridder supplementary material/source or 2SXPS model metadata.
